payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

Given availability 4h, ISSUE-0001::test and implement are likely infeasible/expensive. Provisional preference: claim ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else has materially lower cost or better fit; fallback ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0002::test. Please share intended claims to avoid duplicates.

Linnea follow-up: because objective prioritizes number of completed tasks before cost, I'm flexible among several feasible low-priority tasks. If another agent can only do ISSUE-0002::review efficiently, I can move to ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0002::test/implement. Please coordinate to maximize unique claims.
